name: Diageo Lincolnway RTD Canning - Plainfield IL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Two driveways off W 143rd St (a divided campus boulevard near -88.2174 and an office drive near -88.2154). Street View at both, captured 2023-05 and 2024-07, shows open ungated entries with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at the public road. Internal road junctions also show no checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance. The small orange/red structure at the trailer-yard road junction (41.6245,-88.2173) sits at the drop-yard edge, not on the truck entry path, and is not a multi-window guard booth.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large connected Diageo Plainfield campus: the RTD canning plant, an attached bottling/manufacturing wing with a major tank farm to the north, plus a large detached trailer drop yard on the west. Three distinct building masses.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer storage lot west of the buildings, ~70 trailers visible in rows, capacity ~110.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: East dock bank of the canning building shows a bank of trailers backed in (~15-20 doors visible); additional dock positions on the north building face. Estimate 30 total, moderate confidence given roof glare.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide ungated campus boulevard with ample paved apron width; physical room for express/bypass lane exists.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from 143rd St entrances to docks/drop yard easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Plainfield IL industrial park; farmland abuts the west side. Rural per rubric tie-break.
